ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in irregular streaks and 60% low-intensity black/dark grey pixels providing the base surface color.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe features predominantly vertical and diagonal white striations against a dark background. Right lobe displays more complex mottling, including distinct white circular ring structures and dense white patches in the distal lower quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an approximate vertex angle of 40 degrees; clearly defined boundary separating the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography; high-frequency serrations with pixel-depth variances of 10-30 pixels forming a non-uniform sawtooth pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave upward trajectory along the trailing edge leading to elongated, pointed distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Large, high-contrast, three-dimensional pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with dense barnacle colonization. Several circular white ring-scars are visible on the interior surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of unaligned, high-contrast linear marks (dark on white and white on dark) crossing both lobes, particularly prominent in the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive localized barnacle clusters (calcium carbonate deposits) at the distal tips; significant irregular notch-like missing tissue segments along the trailing edge serrations.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'double-ring' or 'eye' circular scar pattern located in the lower-central region of the right fluke lobe.
